scope: An executable prospective checkpoint-holder and synchronous witness RETAIN coordinator. Three added files; every accepted predecessor byte remains unchanged. This is a single-authority trusted-process filesystem implementation and excluded synthetic model, not an independently deployed network service.
implemented: Provisioned witness registry, distinct 256-bit keys, unique witness and instance enrollment within one authoritative retained journal
Authenticated chained holder journal, full-write/fsync before witness invocation or publication acknowledgement
Witness-key-authenticated checkpoints, holder-key-authenticated nonce-correlated snapshots; requesting client must supply a fresh unpredictable never-reused nonce and retain a revision floor
Serialized exact instance/revision compare-and-set before a global launch tombstone and RETAIN intent
Synchronous invocation of exact accepted AnchorWitness with byte-exact previously published checkpoint; no arbitrary publication API
Publication only after accepted RETAIN returns and a signed checkpoint advances exactly one row; holder revision advances for both intent and publication
Any exception after durable intent leaves that identity pending, with no resume, reset, refill, reenrollment or pending-completion API after restart
If unacknowledged witness RETAIN bytes disappear, separately retained holder intent still prevents reauthorization; if holder intent persistence fails, local RETAIN is never invoked
Publication ACK loss retains published state and global launch tombstone if bytes persist; loss of publication bytes leaves prior durable intent blocking
trust_contract: The holder journal must reside on independently administered durable non-rollback storage outside the witness rollback domain. This implementation does not establish that deployment or detect simultaneous holder/witness rollback.
Exactly one authoritative holder namespace/service must own the registry. flock coordinates one inode only; copied holder journals or independent holders are NOT fenced.

Trusted callers provision keys, registry, paths and exact source. Enrollment is not remote host attestation. Instance strings and key possession do not distinguish credential-sharing clones. CAS permits only one racing operation against a revision at this authority, not global distributed host uniqueness.

Trusted process integration must exclusively route RETAIN through this coordinator. Direct witness access or privileged/private method access can bypass it and must be withheld by separately qualified deployment.

Holder MAC and witness keys require external custody/provisioning/isolation. Symmetric authentication is not nonrepudiation. The source does not provision production secrets or a network-authenticated request transport.
Filesystem/kernel/fsync and stable private namespace are trusted; no hostile privileged or same-size live in-place rewrite, exhaustive power-loss, or independent storage-root acceptance is claimed.

A snapshot is nonce-correlated point-in-time evidence, not a lease or permanently current state. Subsequent RETAIN uses authoritative CAS. The client must independently enforce a persisted revision floor and never reuse a nonce.

Completed witnesses that restart append RECOVER and therefore require a future separately qualified recovery-publication protocol. This component refuses mismatched checkpoints; it does not invent recovery authority. Consumption publication, availability recovery and capacity rollover remain outside this slice.
qualification: 37 new deterministic synthetic unittest methods, local attempt 1 PASS. Positive publish/reopen; enrollment collisions; eight-way cloned-caller CAS race; replay; nonce/key/holder/checkpoint substitution; lost RETAIN, intent and publication bytes/ACKs; corrupt/reordered/partial/missing storage; alias/path/fork; short/zero writes; mutable configuration rejection. No unchanged predecessor suite rerun.
remaining: actual independent rollback-resistant holder and unique deployed authority
network request authentication and client persistent freshness floors
production key custody and storage roots
distributed clone/fork fencing and direct-witness bypass prevention
full supervisor/receiver and continuous lifetime enforcement
VM provenance, full entry paths and hidden generator inputs
reproducible derivative VM/toolchain and immutable platform/kernel/supply chain
canonical manifest and complete admission review
prepared worker, sealed launch and R1 permit
authority_result: Every successful retention/snapshot has admission_authority=false. No seed, allocation, claim, gameplay, sealed worker or experimental outcome. Independent Reviewer B exact-source review and orchestrator adoption required; author qualification is not acceptance.
